description: Non-wire state-machine vectors. Cursor values are exclusive committed positions.

cases.name: state dependencies precede the combined thread head
assertions: group roster target is applied before the thread targets
Group Meta, message, and deletion targets come from one item

cases.name: first page fixes drain target and later pages preserve through
assertions: drain target is 9
the first page belongs to the drain
state sweep is allowed only after cursor equals 9

cases.name: inactive audience forbids query without moving cursor
assertions: message query cursor remains 20

cases.name: same account reactivation preserves cursor and applies local history policy
assertions: query coordinate identity is unchanged
seq 23 through 27 are holes selected by this publisher history policy
the protocol also permits another publisher policy to expose retained positions from the absence

cases.name: message query retry results never move cursor or peer lifecycle
assertions: message query cursor remains 40
peer lifecycle remains healthy

cases.name: a compacted roster dependency move reindexes its thread head
assertions: the newer Group Meta coordinate is atomic with its dependent thread head
unchanged message and deletion coordinates may be force-reindexed

cases.name: forward thread recovery uses the latest permitted start
assertions: forward start equals max of local cursor and resumeAfter
the discarded gap is absent rather than pending
the discarded gap does not imply source-side deletion
role-and-profile-reference group-meta departures commit before messages become visible
message profiles are fetched lazily by exact message coordinate

cases.name: skip-mode reverse starts at latest and remains continuous
assertions: the reverse query does not start at an intermediate sequence
every later reverse page uses the preceding scannedThrough
reverse progress does not move the forward cursor backward

cases.name: profile lookup is lazy and bound to one authorized message version
assertions: profile revision 3 is revealed by the exact message query only when the consumer needs it
the exact message serviceability and current thread authorization are both verified
a message coordinate excluded by local history policy is denied
no current-profile fallback is returned

cases.name: canonical group meta hides pre-authorization delta history
assertions: all audiences read one group-global coordinate space
a new or restored audience cannot enumerate changes before its visibility floor
full recovery exposes the current roster without exposing prior departures
subsequent delta reads begin at or above the audience visibility floor

cases.name: forward and reverse rejoin races converge through group meta
assertions: a rejoined current member may temporarily use an account-domain placeholder in either direction
group meta supplies role and an exact profile reference but no display bytes
group-member profile resolution uses the exact revision selected by committed group meta
message-author profiles are requested lazily with exact thread and seq
group-meta departures carry no body, role, or profile revision
